title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 103
paragraphs: Now while the Persians were still fighting, the Lacedaemonians and those with them arrived and joined in carrying through the rest of the work. Many of the Greeks themselves fell there, especially many of the Sikyonians, along with their commander Perilaos. The Samians serving in the army — in the Median camp and having been stripped of their arms — when they saw that the battle was going against the Persians from the very first, did as much as they could to help the Greeks. The other Ionians, seeing that the Samians had set the example, themselves revolted from the Persians and attacked the barbarians.
